info.title: ProcuraX API
info.description:
ProcuraX — procurement & spend transformation platform.

Purchase-to-pay workflow with deterministic policy enforcement, multi-tenant isolation
(application scoping + PostgreSQL Row-Level Security) and a complete audit trail.

**Design principle:** AI recommends, rules enforce, humans decide on high-risk actions.

post.description: Create a new organisation (tenant) and its first administrator.
Password sign-in. Repeated failures from one address are throttled per e-mail and overall.

post.description:
Build a Zengin 総合振込 file from approved, not yet exported JPY payments.

The included payments become `exported` in the same transaction, so a payment can never be
placed in two files. The file is returned for a person to upload to the bank; nothing is sent.

PolicyConfig-Input.title: PolicyConfig
PolicyConfig-Input.description:
An organisation's approval policy. Stored as versioned JSONB (approval_policies).

Default values are an example policy for a Japanese company (amounts in JPY). They are
configuration, not recommendations; each tenant publishes its own version.
